scope: Planned synthetic cases SB01-SB15 from the storyboard packet. They specify expected behavior; they are not model responses, host runs, generation records, or behavior-quality PASS results. Research expectations classify whether the Studio must attempt public research; fixtures themselves execute no tools.

Asks at most one material question or clearly labels provisional assumptions
Does not force a plot twist, backstory, fixed act structure, or shot count
Keeps sequence choices revisable until the user selects them
